description: A treasury director must finalize a short-term commercial-paper rollover plan for a corporate cash portfolio, deciding how much to retain as cash, which issuers to use, and the maximum maturity, with input from cash forecasting and market risk.

shared_context.S1: The company has $24,000,000 of cash available for short-term investment.
shared_context.S2: A $18,000,000 commercial-paper position matures in 14 days.
shared_context.S3: The preliminary plan is to roll the entire maturing position into 60-day commercial paper issued by Northstar Bank.
shared_context.S4: Elena makes the binding treasury decision.
shared_context.S5: The treasury team conducts a routine ALCO check-in with cash forecasting and market risk before finalizing any rollover of maturing commercial paper.

PF1.text: Malik confirmed this morning that $10,000,000 of payroll, tax, and operating payments will fall due within the next 21 days, and treasury policy requires an additional $2,000,000 operating cushion; he has not yet updated the cash forecast circulated for the rollover meeting.

PF2.text: Jun received a counterparty-risk memo this morning stating that Northstar Bank commercial paper is capped at $6,000,000 and that all new paper must mature within 30 days; Lumen Bank has confirmed capacity for the remaining $6,000,000, but Jun has not yet entered the limits in the investment system.

acceptance_conditions: The rollover must be approved with exactly $12,000,000 retained in cash.
Exactly $6,000,000 must be rolled into Northstar Bank commercial paper.
Exactly $6,000,000 must be rolled into Lumen Bank commercial paper.
No rolled commercial paper may have a maturity longer than 30 days.
The plan must include a written cash-reserve monitoring commitment.

decisive_facts.why: The shared cash balance alone does not identify the required reserve; PF1 changes cash_reserve_usd from an ordinary smaller holdback to exactly $12,000,000 and requires that amount to be cited.

The preliminary plan would place all $18,000,000 with Northstar for 60 days; PF2 changes northstar_cp_usd to exactly $6,000,000, assigns exactly $6,000,000 to Lumen Bank, and changes maximum_maturity_days to no more than 30.
